correctness.rationale: Poissonization gives exact H and K tails. The exact differentiated H has a positive rational numerator whose 79 nonzero integer monomial coefficients are positive in ordered gaps; the z^10 coefficient is strictly positive away from equal rates. This proves strict radial monotonicity on all positive vectors, while strict log-concavity proves the third tail. Exact state recursion independently checked 216 rational rate triples.
